name: Baton Roue / Bike Fall
visual_description: Three-panel webcomic by artist Sheng Wang of a cyclist riding normally, shoving a wooden baton into his own front wheel spokes, and crashing onto the ground clutching his knee.
usage_context: Used to mock self-inflicted harm or poor decisions where the individual immediately shifts blame to someone else.

example.sabotage: STAYING UP UNTIL 4 AM ON MY PHONE
example.blame: DAMN HEADACHES, WHY AM I SO UNLUCKY?
